channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Jane Austen — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “There are few people whom I really love, and still fewer of whom I think well. The more I see of the world, the more am I dissatisfied with it.” — Jane Austen

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “The word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.” — Carl Jung

item.title: H. G. Wells — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “What really matters is what you do with what you have.” — H. G. Wells

item.title: Gautama Buddha — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “Conquer anger with non-anger. Conquer badness with goodness. Conquer meanness with generosity.” — Gautama Buddha

item.title: Pablo Picasso — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “The artist must know the manner whereby to convince others of the truthfulness of his lies.” — Pablo Picasso

item.title: Dalai Lama — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “Do not let the behavior of others destroy your inner peace.” — Dalai Lama

item.title: Shakti Gawain — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “The more light you allow within you, the brighter the world you live in will be.” — Shakti Gawain

item.title: Benjamin Franklin — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Search others for their virtues, thyself for thy vices.” — Benjamin Franklin
